name: Kirishima Nonoka
source: A third-year at Izumigamori Academy. Even though she has good grades at school, she is quite an airhead and clumsy. being a miko at Mitsurugi Shrine, she became some kind of [url=/c26204]Koyori's[/url] follower after she appeared at the collapsed Tori gate.
translation: A third-year at Izumigamori Academy. Even though she has good grades at school, she is quite an airhead and clumsy. being a miko at Mitsurugi Shrine, she became some kind of [url=/c26204]Koyori's[/url] follower after she appeared at the collapsed Tori gate.
